build_training_parser: build an argument parser for training a fairseq model with dataset, distributed, and optimization args
build_generation_parser: build an argument parser for generating text with a trained fairseq translation model
parse_args_and_arch: parse command line arguments and apply model architecture configuration for a fairseq task
build_preprocessing_parser: build an argument parser for preprocessing source and target language data for translation tasks
build_validation_parser: build an argument parser for validating a fairseq model with evaluation configuration
